 Korea Electric Power Corporation Stock 12‑Month Price Target Cut to $15.05, Implies 32% Upside
 Less than 1 min read 015760 According to estimates from 15 analysts, Korea Electric Power Corporation stock's average price target has fallen from $15.77 to $15.05, with forecasts ranging from $9.02 to $22.6 per share 
 Based on the Nov. 11 closing price, the updated target implies approximately 32% potential upside 
 Consensus rating remains at “Buy” across 17 covering analysts, with 10 Buys, 6 Holds and 1 Sells
